name: PT Panin Sekuritas Tbk
summary: PT Panin Sekuritas Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, provides securities brokerage, underwriting, and investment management services in Indonesia. The company engages in the stock, fixed income, and margin trading; regular and sharia online trading; corporate finance and e-IPO; and reverse REPO activities. It also provides asset management services. In addition, it offers construction, agriculture, transportation, and printing services. The company was formerly known as PT Nusamas Panin and changed its name to PT Panin Sekuritas Tbk in June 1995. PT Panin Sekuritas Tbk was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia.
